on 6 August, 2025
 High Court Of Andhra Pradesh
 Main Case No: Crl.P.No.7884 of 2025
 Proceeding Sheet
Sl. Date Order Office

NO. NOTE 02. 06.08.2025 Dr.VJP, J  I.A.No.1 of 2025  Dispensed with for the present.
 Crl.P.No.7884 of 2025
Learned Assistant Public Prosecutor  takes notice for the State/ Respondent No.1.
Learned counsel for the petitioner is permitted to take out personal notice on respondent No.2 through RPAD/Courier and file proof of the same.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner.

Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that earlier, based on the complaint made by the de facto complainant, a case was registered and numbered as C.C. No. 3052 of 2018, wherein the petitioner, being the brother of A1, was acquitted.
Thereafter, it is alleged that A1 committed the murder of the daughter of the de facto complainant.
In the present case, the allegations against the petitioner pertain to an offence under Section 498A IPC.
Learned counsel further submits that the question of invoking Section 498A IPC against the petitioner for the second time does not arise SL. DATE ORDER OFFICE
NO. NOTE since there has been no reunion of the family after the disposal of the earlier calendar case.

Considering the submissions made, there shall be interim stay of all further proceedings, in respect of petitioner herein/A2, in PRC No.16 of 2020 on the file o the learned III Additional Metropolitan Magistrate-cum-III Additional Junior Civil Judge, Vijayawada, till the next date of hearing.
